Early-career programs for first- and second-year EE students

Government and national-lab internships and research programs whose official pages list no junior-standing requirement. Each entry was checked on its official page on September 23, 2026; details change, so confirm dates on the official page before you apply.

Programs are sorted by their next dated deadline. Programs we could not verify (the official page did not load, or did not state eligibility and timing) are left out on purpose. Know one that belongs here? Suggest it.

Programs by next deadline

September 30, 2026 · Spring 2027 term

Science Undergraduate Laboratory Internships (SULI)

U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science (Workforce Development for Teachers and Scientists)

Deadlines
Spring 2027 term: September 30, 2026, 5:00 p.m. ET. Fall 2026 applications are closed.
Who can apply
Undergraduate students and recent graduates majoring in a STEM field or science policy. The official page lists the full eligibility rules.
Class year
The page does not set a minimum class year.
Format
10-week summer internship (May to August) or a semester (August to December, or January to May).
Pay
Paid internship.
Checked

About January 31, 2027 (end of January 2027; exact date not yet posted) · Summer 2027

Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)

National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

Deadlines
Applications are due at the end of January 2027. NIST expects the USAJOBS vacancy announcement to open in mid-October 2026.
Who can apply
Full-time undergraduates at accredited two- or four-year U.S. colleges who are U.S. citizens or U.S. permanent residents and at least 18 years old. First-year undergraduates and graduating seniors are eligible.
Class year
The page states that first-year undergraduates are eligible.
Format
11-week summer research fellowship.
Pay
2026 stipend: $7,810 for 11 weeks ($710 per week), with limited housing and travel support for students who relocate.
Restrictions
US person / PR
Checked
Verified on the official page on September 23, 2026.

February 26, 2027 · Summer 2027

NASA OSTEM Internships

NASA Office of STEM Engagement

Deadlines
Summer 2027: February 26, 2027. Fall 2027: May 21, 2027 (11:59 p.m. ET). The Spring 2027 deadline was September 14, 2026.
Who can apply
U.S. citizens, at least 16 years old, with at least a 3.0/4.0 GPA, enrolled full or part time in college (undergraduate through graduate). STEM and non-STEM majors.
Class year
No minimum class year is stated. NASA also lists Pathways Internships (U.S. citizens, 2.9 GPA, at least 15 semester hours completed), applied for through USAJOBS.
Format
Spring, summer and fall sessions. Applications go through the NASA STEM Gateway.
Pay
Most interns receive a stipend based on academic level and session length.
Restrictions
US citizen
Checked
Verified on the official page on September 23, 2026. Application portal.

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory student internships

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

Deadlines
Summer positions are generally posted September through February; phone interviews happen December through April.
Who can apply
Community college, undergraduate and graduate students. International students can be eligible; visa sponsorship support varies by position. Selected students complete a federal background check and drug screen.
Class year
No minimum class year is stated.
Format
Science and engineering internships through internal and external programs.
Pay
Not stated on the page we checked.
Checked
Verified on the official page on September 23, 2026.

No fixed date

Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU) Sites

U.S. National Science Foundation

Deadlines
Set by each REU site. Students apply to sites directly, not to NSF; use the NSF search to find electrical and computer engineering sites.
Who can apply
Undergraduates who are U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals or U.S. permanent residents. The NSF page does not restrict by class year; each site runs its own selection.
Class year
Individual sites may prefer certain years; read each site's page.
Format
Summer research at a university or lab site funded by NSF.
Pay
See each site's page for stipend and housing details.
Restrictions
US person / PR
Checked
Verified on the official page on September 23, 2026. Application portal.

No fixed date

Sandia National Laboratories internships and co-ops

Sandia National Laboratories (operated for the U.S. Department of Energy)

Deadlines
No fixed deadline on the page: apply to current openings. Summer internships run 10 to 12 weeks (typically May to August); co-ops run 3 to 8 months during the academic year.
Who can apply
At least 16 years old and enrolled full time (typically 12 units for undergraduates) at an accredited college, university or high school. Minimum 3.0/4.0 GPA for R&D, technical and business positions. U.S. citizenship for positions that require a security clearance or where the posting says so.
Class year
No minimum class year is stated.
Format
Summer internships, co-ops and year-round internships for local students, plus themed intern institutes.
Pay
Paid; the rate depends on credit hours, classification and degree level.
Restrictions
Clearance
Checked
Verified on the official page on September 23, 2026.

Making these work in your first two years

  • Read eligibility first: several programs require U.S. citizenship or permanent residency, and some set GPA or age minimums.
  • For research programs such as NSF REU sites and NIST SURF, a short note about a project you built (a board, a driver, a measurement) usually says more than a list of courses.
  • National labs post many student roles on their own career sites; filter by "student" or "intern" and check back from September onward.

First Silicon lists hardware, EE, embedded and semiconductor internships from employers' public job boards. Last data update: September 24, 2026.

Built by Mahir Patel, an electrical-engineering student at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. Not affiliated with any listed employer. Labels are automatic; always check the employer's posting. Not career, legal or immigration advice.
